title: Harry Styles Teases New Music Video (and Toned Legs) With Cheeky ‘Dance No More’ Clip
summary: It'll mark the third visual for Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally.
contentText:
Harry Styles has got his dancing shoes on. The pop star posted a teaser for his next Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally music video on Wednesday (May 6), revealing that the visual for “Dance No More” is coming soon.

Related

Harry Styles Is Engaged to Zoe Kravitz, According to Reports

Harry Styles Shares Surprise Studio Sessions Clip ‘Harry Live From Funkhaus’

Harry Styles Is Going Back on Tour This Year With a 7-City Residency: Here Are the Dates

In a clip of the visual Styles posted on Instagram, a door squeaks open to reveal the Grammy winner’s toned bare legs in a tiny pair shorts, stepping out onto an open floor in white sneakers. It then cuts to a shot of him smiling wide, cheekily licking a microphone he’s carrying with him.

“Dance No More. May 7, 17:00 UK,” he wrote in the caption.

“Dance No More” will mark the third visual from Styles’ Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally universe, following videos for Billboard Hot 100 -topping lead single “”Aperture” and second single “American Girls.” The album dropped in March and spent two weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 .

The One Direction alum is currently gearing up to kick off his Together, Together tour in less than two weeks. The series of mini-residencies will begin with a stint in Amsterdam, followed by stops in London, New York City and more cities around the globe.

The new music video is also coming shortly after reports emerged that Styles is now an engaged man. Rumored partner Zoe Kravitz stepped out with what appeared to be a large diamond on her left ring finger in April, leading to the speculation.
